fuel_consumption.source_quote: a one-cent change in our fuel price per gallon would have impacted our 2024 raw fuel expense by approximately $9 million

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel hedge program suspended in Q4 2023. As of December 31, 2024, only run-off positions remain: Alaska had 20 million gallons settling through March 2025, and newly-acquired Hawaiian Airlines had 47 million gallons settling through September 2025. Total run-off = 67M gallons. Fair value was not material at Dec 31, 2024. Losses recognized in aircraft fuel were $10M in 2024. Company acquired Hawaiian Airlines on September 18, 2024. Annual fuel consumption significantly higher due to Hawaiian fleet addition (~900M gal implied from $9M/cent sensitivity).
